summary: Gogoro prices are now readable from Gogoro's own data: EZZY NT$59,980 (NT$61,980 in four new colours, campaign price 59,980 to 2026-12-31), EZZY 500 74,980, VIVA MIX BELT 76,980, Luna 83,980, Delight 89,800, Pulse 109,800. Every Gogoro model on the MOEA approved list gets the NT$7,000 central subsidy (EZZY is 普通輕型第1級, the rest heavy class); the NT$3,000 domestic-cell bonus is unproven, so do not count on it. The subsidy period ends 2026-12-31. Tariff: NT$319 plan = 87 Ah, overage NT$2.3 per Ah; NT$488/888 plans need 24 months; the $0 plan charges NT$1.1 per Ah after a NT$6,000 (single) or NT$9,000 (dual) setup fee. EZZY 500 is dual-battery. The NT$168 monthly price is a 24-month promotion on EZZY only, ending with 2026-12-31 orders. Warranty is 2 years, unlimited km; routine service about NT$130-390 per visit for EZZY-class bikes (about NT$1,000 at 20,000 km). Finances: Q3 net loss US$3.4m, NT$2.5bn equity completed, but about US$117m falls due within 12 months and guidance was cut, so network continuity is not guaranteed. Gen-1 battery retirement impact on owners is unstated.

findings.subject: MOEA/ITRI approved-vehicle list (補助車款) for brand 睿能: plate class per model code

None is 普通重型第2級, 普通輕型第2級 or 小型輕型, so every listed Gogoro code is in the NT$7,000 central tier (the 7,000 / 5,100 amounts are now verified from MOEA's own table, see moea-central-subsidy-table). Codes: GB7EL, GB7CT, GSB7BTJ, GSP6DT, GB6RD, GP7VE, GM7R2, GX7E2, GX6C2, GU8E2, GU8J2, GU8G2, GJ6B2, GJ6C2, GJ7U2, GB6NA, GX7E2(郵政車), GE3GS, GE5XK, GS1L. Name matching is still partial and rests on portal image filenames only: GE3GS=EZZY, GX6C2=CrossOver S, GX7E2=CrossOver, GM7R2=Delight, GJ6B2/GJ6C2=VIVA MIX, GB7EL/GSB7BTJ=SuperSport, GB6RD=2 Premium, GB7CT=2 Plus. findings.subject: NT$3,000 domestic battery-cell bonus (國產電池芯) for Gogoro models
findings.valueText: No source I could open shows any Gogoro model as eligible, and none shows any Gogoro model as ineligible. The bonus itself exists: MOEA's table lists '國產電池芯車款 加碼補助 3,000'. I reproduced the portal result: the 電池芯 '國產' filter returns zero cards for 睿能 and for all brands combined, and the approved-model CSV has no battery-cell column. Gogoro's own subsidy-calculator data file (cdn.gogoro.com/data/subsidy.json, last modified 2026-11-23) shows only the NT$7,000 central line (NT$8,000 for two-stroke trade-in) and has no domestic-cell line at all. Do not promise the NT$3,000 on any Gogoro model; treat it as unproven.
findings.conditions: Zero results for every brand suggests the filter or data is empty, not that nobody qualifies. The rule text (定義 of 國產電池芯車款) is in the 補助要點 on law.moea.gov.tw, which blocks automated requests (HTTP 403 Cloudflare page).
findings.sourcePublisher: 經濟部產業發展署 / 工研院
findings.sourceTitle: 補助車款 - 電動機車產業網
findings.verifierNote: Could not settle eligibility. Added the evidence that the bonus line is real (MOEA PDF table) and that Gogoro's own calculator does not include it. Ask the shop for written confirmation or call the MOEA programme hotline 0800-527-027.

findings.subject: EZZY product page headline plan price (NT$168 per month)
findings.valueText: The EZZY page shows '限時每月資費 $168 起'. The campaign page explains it: the NT$319 自由省 plan minus a NT$151 monthly credit for 24 consecutive months (total NT$3,624), for new EZZY (single battery) buyers who order between 2026-09-08 and 2026-12-31 and activate the battery service. The NT$151 credit also applies to the NT$429 and NT$529 高用量自由省 plans and the NT$488 騎到飽 plan, so those would cost NT$278 / NT$378 / NT$337 after the credit (derived). After month 24 the plan reverts to its normal fee. The credit only offsets the base fee, is lost if you change plan, sell or transfer the vehicle, and is not carried over unused.
findings.period: 2026-09-08 to 2026-12-31 (order, full payment and invoice inside the period)
findings.conditions: Fine print: '本專案不得與Gogoro指定之其他含車價折扣以及當期促銷之專案或特定優惠方案併同使用', and Gogoro decides whether it may be combined. The same page headlines the NT$2,000 colour discount next to NT$168, but the fine print does not promise they stack. The NT$2,000 discount applies only to the four new colours (淺粉、灰藍、淺棕、淡綠), price after discount NT$59,980.
findings.sourceTitle: Gogoro EZZY 新車限時專屬資費優惠 每月折抵 $151（24 個月）
findings.verifierNote: Opened the official campaign page. Figure and dates confirmed. Added: eligible plans, 24-month limit, loss of credit on plan change or transfer, and that stacking with the vehicle-price discount is at Gogoro's discretion, not promised. This is a promotion, not the tariff.

findings.subject: Gogoro Network plan table (roo.cash July 2025 transcription) checked against Gogoro's own support pages
findings.valueText: Confirmed from Gogoro's own support pages (opened): 自由省 NT$319 = single battery, 87 Ah (about 135 km); 二顆電池 NT$319 also exists (87 Ah, about 106 km); 自由省 NT$519 = two batteries, 260.9 Ah (about 318 km); 自由省 NT$819 = two batteries, 521.7 Ah (about 637 km). 高用量自由省 NT$529 single battery gets NT$1,300 of battery-fee credit = 565.2 Ah (about 879 km); NT$1,269 two-battery gets NT$3,000 credit = 1,304.3 Ah (about 1,594 km). Credit per Ah works out at NT$2.30. Contract lengths: 高用量自由省 contract 18 months; 騎到飽 (488/888) 24 months; $0月租 24 months. NT$429 (single) appears on Gogoro's campaign page as a 高用量自由省 plan. NOT confirmed on any Gogoro page I could open: 預選里程 NT$529/NT$849 and their NT$2.6/NT$1.6 per km overage, and NT$969. The first researcher's puzzle over 135 km per 87 Ah is explained: Gogoro's estimate is 87 Ah x 1.4 km/Ah = 121.8 km, then divided by 0.9 for an assumed average 10% dynamic discount = 135 km. Gogoro's 1.4 km/Ah (single battery) and 1.1 km/Ah (two batteries) are fleet averages from 2021 data.

findings.subject: Any announced 2026 tariff increase
findings.valueText: I found no 2026 price increase on existing plans in Gogoro's 2026 news list, its campaign pages or the support tariff pages. The only new plan is 騎到飽 488/888. Gogoro's Q3 2026 release says a higher mix of low-mileage subscribers slightly tempered ARPU, a margin pressure not a price change. Gogoro reserves the right to change or cancel plans without individual notice (488/888 terms, clause 16), so past stability does not guarantee future tariffs.
findings.quote: While a higher mix of low-mileage subscribers slightly tempered average revenue per user (“ARPU”)
findings.conditions: Absence of an announcement is not proof.

findings.sourceTitle: Gogoro Releases Third Quarter Financial Results
findings.verifierNote: Quote opened and present. The absence claim cannot be proven; kept SECONDARY. Added the reservation-of-rights clause from Gogoro's own 488/888 page.

findings.subject: Gogoro Q3 2026 results (released 2026-11-11)
findings.valueText: Q3 2026: net loss US$3.4m (Q3 2025: US$14.9m). Revenue US$70.6m, down 9.1% (hardware and others US$33.5m, down 13.5%; battery swapping service revenue US$37.1m, down 4.7%, up 1.8% at constant currency). Gross margin 24.4%. Adjusted EBITDA US$19.0m (prior year US$20.2m). Operating cash inflow for nine months US$27.9m (prior US$25.7m). Cash at 2026-09-30 US$68.9m, including the US$16.7m from Gold Sino. Subscribers 684,000 (+4% on 657,000). Gogoro-branded and PBGN scooter registrations down 9.7%. Full-year 2026 revenue guidance cut from US$285-305m (Q2 release) to US$270-290m, about 95% from Taiwan; free cash flow expected 2027, profitability 2028.
findings.quote: For the third quarter, net loss was $3.4 million, representing a decrease of $11.5 million from a net loss of $14.9 million in the same period last year.
findings.conditions: Net loss is helped by a US$7.7m drop in battery-upgrade costs after the programme ended in Q4 2025. The company's own risk list includes ability to repay, refinance or extend borrowings and dependence on a director to procure equity financing.
findings.sourceTitle: Gogoro Releases Third Quarter Financial Results
findings.verifierNote: Every number above was read in the opened release text. The 'energy break-even dropped from the outlook' point is now verified directly: the Q2 release said 'We remain on track for the Gogoro Network battery-swapping business to achieve non-IFRS profitability in 2026', and the Q3 guidance paragraph no longer says so (it states only free cash flow 2027 and profitability 2028). The 'underlying loss about US$7.3m' figure is an analyst claim I did not verify.

findings.subject: NT$2.5bn equity undertaking completed
findings.unit: USD million (second and final round, Oct 2026)
findings.valueText: Completed. First tranche: 5,300,000 shares to Gold Sino Assets for about US$16.7m in March 2026. Second and final round: 24,936,057 shares at US$2.48, about US$61.8m received on closing 2026-10-13. Together about US$78.5m, described by Gogoro as the 'equity funding commitment of up to NT$2.5 billion' secured by a director. Balance sheet at 2026-09-30 (before the October money): borrowings current US$92.3m plus financial liabilities at amortised cost current US$25.0m (about US$117m due within 12 months), borrowings non-current US$245.2m, total current liabilities US$200.8m against current assets US$138.7m, cash US$68.9m, total equity US$108.0m. So refinancing risk is real; the October equity roughly covers the working-capital gap.
findings.quote: In October 2026, we received an additional $61.8 million in equity proceeds from the second and final round of funding under this commitment.
findings.conditions: Primary investor site investor.gogoro.com returns HTTP 403 to automated requests; the republished copy was used.
findings.sourceTitle: Gogoro Releases Third Quarter Financial Results
findings.verifierNote: Quote and share numbers confirmed. Debt figures were SECONDARY in the first pass; I read them in the release's own balance sheet and they match (92.3 + 25.0 = 117.3). That the two tranches add up exactly to NT$2.5bn is not stated in the release; only 'up to NT$2.5 billion' is.

findings.subject: Company statements on battery-network continuity, 2026
findings.valueText: Gogoro's own press release of 2026-02-25 says the Gen-1 battery is fully retired this year, NT$10億 is reinvested in the energy business, over 100 new GoStations are planned in core hot zones, 'worst-ten' battery removal continues, and a smaller GoStation Q (one-third footprint, ordinary 220V) is piloted in Taiwan at year-end and enters Vietnam in 2027. Stated goals (Feb): energy business break-even 2026, free cash flow 2027, vehicle business break-even 2028. The Q2 release (2026-08-25) still said energy break-even in 2026; the Q3 release (2026-11-11) no longer does. No statement from 經濟部 on network continuity was found. Two further facts: Gogoro's site says over 1.3 million batteries have been put into service; Gogoro's own risk factors list refinancing and dependence on a director for equity.
findings.quote: 第一代電池已完成階段性任務，於今年全面退役，並將再投資新台幣 10 億元用於支持能源事業穩健發展；而在全台換電需求的核心熱區，Gogoro 也預計新增逾 100 座 GoStation
findings.conditions: The official URL slug says 2025-2-25 but the page is dated 2026/2/25 and covers 2025 results. Corroboration: 數位時代 https://www.bnext.com.tw/article/90156/2026-gogoro-newplan quotes 'Gogoro表示，將在全台高需求熱區新增超過100座換電站，並更嚴格執行「末位管理制度」。'
findings.sourcePublisher: Gogoro 台灣 (official press release); 數位時代
findings.sourceTitle: Gogoro 營運體質顯著優化：2025 年營運現金流增 2 倍、EBITDA 創新高
findings.verifierNote: Both the bnext article and Gogoro's own release were opened. Upgrade: the primary source is now the company's press release (VERIFIED) and the dropped 2026 energy break-even target is verified from the Q2 and Q3 releases rather than an analyst. Plus the bnext figures 70.8萬 (2025 market) and 2.8萬 (Gogoro 2025 registrations) are in the article text.

findings.subject: Retirement of first-generation batteries in 2026
findings.valueText: Gogoro's own words (press release 2026-02-25): the Gen-1 battery has 'completed its stage mission and is fully retired this year'. In 2025 it renewed 50,000 batteries per month, double 2024, and swap satisfaction rose 26% in two years. Gogoro's own words say nothing about owners of older vehicles: no deadline, compensation, trade-in, compatibility or tariff consequence is stated anywhere I could open. The retirement concerns battery packs in the swap network; whether any vehicle stops being supported is unstated. The Q3 2026 release says the battery upgrade programme finished at the end of 2025 and lists 'retirement of first-generation batteries' among its capex risks.
findings.quote: Gogoro 宣布見證台灣電動車產業十年發展的第一代電池已完成階段性任務，於今年全面退役
findings.conditions: Owner impact remains unknown. Anyone buying a second-hand Gogoro with an older vehicle should ask Gogoro in writing.
findings.sourceTitle: Gogoro 營運體質顯著優化
findings.verifierNote: First researcher had only the T客邦 paraphrase (SECONDARY). Gogoro's own wording was found and matches. The owner-impact gap is not closed by it.

findings.subject: Scheduled maintenance price and base warranty
findings.valueText: The first researcher found no official figures; they exist. Gogoro Care states a '2 年不限里程保固'; if the powertrain is replaced or repaired inside the 2 years, one extra year of cover from the repair date; a paid 3-year extended warranty can be bought before the 2 years end (Luna promo shows NT$4,200 value, NT$1,500 promo). Intervals (Gogoro Care): first service at 1,000 km or 2 months (whichever first) for most models; 5,000 km or 6 months for 輪轂馬達 / 輕保養勁速馬達 models; Pulse 3,000 km or 6 months. Regular service every 3,000 km or 6 months (Pulse and others) or 5,000 km or 6 months (hub-motor and light-service models). Official price table, see gogoro-maintenance-official-prices. The third-party NT$500-800 per visit and VIVA NT$300 claim is out of date: official routine visits for EZZY-class bikes are NT$130-390 (about NT$1,000 at 20,000 km).
findings.period: Gogoro Care pages read 2026-11-25; price file modified 2026-06-29
findings.conditions: Prices are estimates for normal use; consumables are charged extra; the final quote follows inspection.
findings.sourceTitle: 產品保障 - Gogoro Care
findings.verifierNote: The finding said UNVERIFIED and 'do not publish'; the official warranty and price data are reachable by curl (the price calculator loads maintprice.json). The third-party snippet is refuted for current models.

findings.subject: Official Gogoro certified pre-owned programme
findings.valueText: No official certified pre-owned programme found. The official 2026 news index (gogoro.com/tw/news, pages 1-4) and the Gogoro Care pages list none. The old trade-in campaign is for gasoline scooters. Third-party used price tables exist but are not official. Absence is not proof.

findings.subject: Gogoro Network tariff plans in force (monthly fee, Ah, rate, battery count, contract)
findings.valueText: 自由省 (no contract stated on the pages opened): NT$319 single battery, 87 Ah; NT$319 two-battery, 87 Ah; NT$519 two-battery, 260.9 Ah; NT$819 two-battery, 521.7 Ah. 高用量自由省 (contract 18 months, penalty NT$1,800 single / NT$5,400 dual, scaled by remaining days / 540): NT$429 single (contract) and NT$529 single (NT$1,300 credit, 565.2 Ah); NT$1,269 dual (NT$3,000 credit, 1,304.3 Ah). Overage / extra use NT$2.3 per Ah (verified on the 488/888 page; the credit-to-Ah ratio of the 高用量 plans also gives 2.30). 騎到飽 488 (single) / 888 (dual), 24-month contract, free swaps 10:00-16:00 and 22:00-06:00, other times NT$2.3/Ah, penalty NT$2,400 single / NT$7,200 dual scaled by days / 730; no scheduled-service package or free performance upgrade included; Gogoro may remove users above 1,600 Ah for two months who use the bike commercially. Energy per Ah (Gogoro 2021 fleet average): 1.4 km/Ah single battery, 1.1 km/Ah two batteries. Dynamic discount up to 20% off at some stations. Derived cost per km at 1.4 km/Ah: 319 plan 2.62/km if the 87 Ah are fully used (2.36 with Gogoro's assumed 10% discount); overage 1.64/km. Derived, not Gogoro figures.
findings.quote: 每月贈送的 1300 元電池使用費折抵金，約等於贈送 565.2 安時
findings.conditions: Support articles carry no date. NT$969 and 預選里程 NT$529/849 not verified officially. Monthly fee for 自由省 is the plan name; the Ah and credit for 自由省 come from the km articles, not from a price table.
findings.sourceTitle: [資費方案]高用量自由省方案; [資費方案]自由省方案; 騎到飽 488/888
findings.verifierNote: Closes most of gap 2. 488/888 details re-read from https://promotion.gogoro.com/tw/488-888-all-you-can-ride/ and penalties from https://network-support.gogoro.com/tw/articles/8553212301073508.

findings.subject: $0月租 pay-per-use plan: rate, setup fee, contract
findings.valueText: NT$1.1 per Ah, 24-month contract. One-off setup fee NT$6,000 (single battery) or NT$9,000 (two batteries); the fee is not prepaid battery credit. Setup fee can be fully or partly waived with designated models or card offers. Early termination: penalty = NT$4,800 (single) or NT$7,200 (dual) x remaining / total contract period, and the setup fee is refunded pro rata. Renewal after 24 months needs a new setup fee. Gogoro says roughly NT$1 per km for two-battery vehicles; for a single-battery bike at 1.4 km/Ah that is about NT$0.79/km (derived). For a single-battery bike the setup fee equals NT$250 per month over 24 months (derived).
findings.quote: 您只要支付了$6000(單顆電池) / $9000(雙顆電池) 方案設定費，在接下來的24個月內，都可以享有獨家每安時1.1元的電池使用費
findings.conditions: Also stated on https://www.gogoro.com/tw/event/2025-payg/ (the page name says 2025; text still live).
findings.sourceTitle: $0月租方案是什麼?
findings.verifierNote: Official confirmation of the rate, setup fees, term and penalty base.

findings.subject: Official Gogoro Care routine-service price estimates (NTD, normal use, consumables extra)
findings.valueText: Read from Gogoro Care's price data (maintprice.json) and the page's selection logic. Per visit: EZZY (5,000 km steps) 290 / 195 (10k, 30k) / 290 / 955 (20k, 40k). Adding the eight visits to 40,000 km: 3,460 (derived). EZZY 500: 130 / 260 (10k, 30k) / 130 / 1,020 (20k, 40k); eight visits 3,080 (derived). Luna: 195 / 390 (10k, 30k) / 195 / 1,085 (20k, 40k); eight visits 3,730 (derived). VIVA MIX BASIC/KEYLESS (also XL BASIC/KEYLESS): 865 at 1,000 km, then 535 every 3,000 km, 995 at 10k and 28k, 1,950 at 19k and 37k. Delight and VIVA MIX BELT/ME/SUPERFAST: 785, then 455, 915 at 10k and 28k, 1,870 at 19k and 37k. VIVA XL BELT/ME/SUPERFAST: 720, then 390, 850, 1,805. CrossOver, SuperSport, Premium: 655, then 455, 785 at 10k and 28k, 1,740 at 19k and 37k. Pulse (3,000 km steps): 390 normally, 785 at 12k, 1,085 at 18k and 24k, 1,480 at 36k.
findings.conditions: Model-to-price-type mapping comes from https://www.gogoro.com/tw/gogorocare/js/data.js (the page's own script), which I read and applied; it is my reading of Gogoro's code, not a printed table. Page notice: consumables are charged separately and the actual quote follows inspection.
findings.sourceTitle: 車輛保養價格 - Gogoro Care
findings.verifierNote: Closes gap 3 for routine service. Check the model-to-row mapping against the live page (needsManualFetch) before publishing.

findings.subject: Official vehicle warranty terms
findings.valueText: 2 years unlimited-km warranty; if powertrain parts are replaced or repaired within the 2 years, one additional year from the repair date; non-consumable parts sold by Gogoro 90 days or 1 year; genuine accessories up to 1 year; a paid extended warranty (up to 3 years total) can be bought before the 2 years end. Free roadside rescue and free parts for faults covered by warranty. The page does not give a separate motor warranty length beyond the powertrain extension.
findings.quote: 新車保固 2 年內，若更換或維修動力總成相關部件，自完成維修更換日起，額外提供一年延長保固。
findings.sourceTitle: 產品保障 - Gogoro Care
findings.verifierNote: Closes gap 3 for warranty. Battery packs are covered by the Network contract, not described here.

findings.subject: Gogoro Q2 2026 results (released 2026-08-24/25)
findings.valueText: Net loss US$4.9m (Q2 2025: US$26.5m). Revenue US$70.6m, up 7.3% (up 10.0% at constant currency). Gross margin 22.6%. Subscribers 677,000 (+4%). Six-month operating cash flow US$26.0m. Then-guidance: 2026 revenue US$285-305m and 'on track for the Gogoro Network battery-swapping business to achieve non-IFRS profitability in 2026'. Q1 2026 was not separately checked.
findings.quote: For the second quarter, net loss was $4.9 million, representing a decrease of $21.6 million from a net loss of $26.5 million in the same period last year.
findings.sourceTitle: Gogoro Releases Second Quarter Financial Results
findings.verifierNote: Gogoro's Chinese release of 2026-08-25 (gogoro.com/tw/news/2026-8-25-gogoro-q2-earnings/) gives the same net loss (490萬美元).

findings.subject: Battery count and plate colour of the two cheapest models, per Gogoro's own pages
findings.valueText: EZZY: single battery (campaign page: '購買單顆電池之全新智慧電動機車 EZZY'), advertised for 綠牌 ('挑戰綠牌最速 68 km/h'), 50cc class in Gogoro's data. EZZY 500: '雙電池配置', '白牌動力新選擇', 125cc class. This matters for the plan: dual-battery bikes cannot use the single-battery NT$319/429/529 plans; dual plans start at NT$319 (87 Ah, about 106 km), NT$519, NT$819 or NT$1,269, and the $0 plan setup fee is NT$9,000. Also, the NT$168 campaign applies to EZZY only (single battery), not EZZY 500.
findings.quote: 白牌動力新選擇 全新的輕保養勁速馬達 500，讓你加速恣意暢快！ 雙電池配置 更高續航力，日常使用更給力！
findings.sourceTitle: Gogoro EZZY 500
findings.verifierNote: Dual-battery status of EZZY 500 is important for running costs; the first sweep did not carry it.
